calendar.prepare:
PREPARE qp_calendar AS SELECT bookings.id, bookings.start_at, bookings.end_at, booking_items.quantity 
FROM bookings JOIN booking_items ON bookings.id = booking_items.booking_id 
WHERE booking_items.product_id = $1 AND (bookings.status IN ($6, $7) OR bookings.status = $2 AND bookings.expires_at > $3) AND bookings.start_at < $4 AND bookings.end_at > $5

physical_out.prepare:
PREPARE qp_physical_out AS SELECT coalesce(sum(booking_items.quantity), $1) AS coalesce_1 
FROM booking_items JOIN bookings ON booking_items.booking_id = bookings.id 
WHERE booking_items.product_id = $2 AND bookings.status = $3

alternatives.prepare:
PREPARE qp_alternatives AS SELECT products.id, products.sku, products.name, products.category, products.capacity, products.daily_rate_cents, reservations.booking_id, reservations.start_at, reservations.end_at, reservations.status, reservations.quantity 
FROM products LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT booking_items.product_id AS product_id, bookings.id AS booking_id, bookings.start_at AS start_at, bookings.end_at AS end_at, bookings.status AS status, booking_items.quantity AS quantity 
FROM booking_items JOIN bookings ON booking_items.booking_id = bookings.id 
WHERE booking_items.product_id IN ($6, $7, $8, $9, $10) AND (bookings.status = $1 OR (bookings.status IN ($11, $12) OR bookings.status = $2 AND bookings.expires_at > $3) AND bookings.start_at < $4 AND bookings.end_at > $5)) AS reservations ON products.id = reservations.product_id 
WHERE products.id IN ($13, $14, $15, $16, $17)
